content.title: Three-Stage Cyber Infiltration | Arrival, Competence Proof, Interior Reveal
content.summary: A signal auditor moves from rooftop arrival through sensor proof to a control-room reveal. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One masked adult identity persists across all spaces. + The exterior arrival precedes one bounded competence proof. + A visible access cue motivates the interior transition. + The target room is spatially distinct but causally connected. + Identity reveal occurs only after the final threshold closes.
quick_start.recommended_input: Drop one masked adult signal auditor onto an original rain-dark relay-station roof with a copper cable coil. Hold one glove and mask close view as a green access light activates on the same door. Only after the door seals, let the auditor remove the mask and place the copper coil on the desk.
required_anchors: One masked adult identity persists across all spaces.
The exterior arrival precedes one bounded competence proof.
The target room is spatially distinct but causally connected.
Identity reveal occurs only after the final threshold closes.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A signal auditor moves from rooftop arrival through sensor proof to a control-room reveal. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.
